head: 10 new graphic design apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: Ten design and drawing apps released in the last 60 days rose into the US App Store's Graphics & Design charts this week, from the 3D renderer RAYS to Wallmix's wallpapers and widgets.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store Graphics & Design charts this week
means: If you design, paint or just like to customize your phone, these are small new tools people are paying for right now; most are one-time purchases.
todo: Check each App Store page for the price, in-app purchases and which iPhone or iPad it needs before you buy.

list.name: RAYS - 3D Path Tracer
list.what: Renders photo-like images of 3D models on iPhone and iPad with the device's hardware ray tracing.

list.name: Snowflaker
list.what: Turns any name into its own snowflake design that you can color, save and share.

list.name: Color Jar: Picker & Palettes
list.what: Picks colors from the camera, photos or screenshots and saves them, ready to copy as hex and other codes.

list.name: Coloring with Farah
list.what: Seven wordless picture-story coloring books with 127 pages, for children from 3 and for adults.

list.name: MESONA
list.what: A kit for designing your own character or avatar, with outfits, colors and details you draw yourself.

list.name: WAY: COLOR YOUR WAY
list.what: Reads a color from a photo and shows the colors that go with it under ten color harmonies.

list.name: Font Shelf
list.what: Installs fonts you already own on iPhone and iPad, from single font files or zip downloads.

list.name: Porcela Lithophane Maker
list.what: Turns a photo into a flat or curved lithophane file for 3D printing, made on your device.

list.name: Henfolio
list.what: Lets painters keep a timeline of each artwork, with photos, studio sessions and notes.

list.name: Wallmix - Wallpapers & Widgets
list.what: Wallpapers plus Lock Screen widgets you build from your own text and photos.
